checks: Each lease has a distinct port, token and TLS key; public DTO contains no private key
Unique trust anchor and server name authenticate each endpoint and preserve split SSE/UTF-8
Wrong lease CA, empty trust store and wrong server name fail before provider dispatch
Scoped endpoint rejects foreign/sibling-mode tokens and pipe token cannot bypass via generic HTTP
Alternate routes, absolute URLs, methods and missing/malformed auth are denied
Duplicate Authorization is rejected rather than selecting one of competing tokens
Global and per-user limits are shared across scoped endpoints and the generic listener
Silent upstream cancels on downstream disconnect and user concurrency immediately recovers
Release cancels an active SSE and closes its listener while another user stays available
Same-user sibling token cannot cross endpoints; repeated release leaves the sibling available
Replacement Worker rejects the previous TLS identity and previous lease token
Binding disablement tears down the scoped TLS listener and its active stream
Downstream abort while the provider has buffered its final response releases concurrency
Delivered successful terminal permits consumer close while provider stays open and releases concurrency
Absent, incomplete or non-success terminal frames remain cancellations and release concurrency
A completed event with nested response.error remains failure and releases concurrency
An observed provider error after the terminal remains failure and releases concurrency
Audit excludes model credentials, lease tokens and TLS private keys
Broker shutdown closes all scoped listeners and resolves lease cleanup
